news.title: AI 末日还是 Pre-IPO 的公关噱头？
news.snippet: 在准备应对生存危机前，先冷静看待 AI 风险炒作。
news.raw_snippet:
Before you start preparing for an existential crisis, take a close look at the financial calendar.

AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are actively preparing for public offerings and sitting on multi-billion-dollar private valuations, while facing immense pressure to justify those figures to Wall Street.

Preparing for a possible IPO means keeping AI at the center of the global news cycle. And as the old saying goes, any PR is good PR.

Inc Logo [...] AI is not an evil villain wanting to intentionally harm us. At its core, AI is a hyper-efficient problem solver. When assigned an objective, it calculates a path to complete it. Without proper constraints and oversight, it might use flawed logic to reach a solution. This is an issue with execution.

The real risk: Operational missteps [...] 3. Human-in-the-loop oversight: Define accountability frameworks so critical strategic, legal, or financial decisions always require human verification.

4. Continuous auditability: Track AI tool inventory, vendor security posture, and ongoing output reliability to maintain full compliance readiness.

The headlines may be PR noise, but risk management is an immediate priority. Business leaders who build structured governance today will scale safely tomorrow.

news.title: 律师事务所会成为下一家大型 AI 科技公司吗？
news.snippet: 随着专业法律 AI 技术成熟，律所正探索向 AI 平台转型。
news.raw_snippet:
The financial appeal of legal AI has grown as specialist technology companies have attracted major investment.

In September 2026, legal AI company Harvey raised $550 million in a funding round that valued the business at $15.5 billion. Rival Legora reached a valuation of $5.6 billion in April following another investment round.

These valuations help explain the interest at Freshfields. [...] The proposed spin-off of Freshfields Lab could attract outside investors and eventually lead to an initial public offering (IPO). Partners have discussed the possibility of creating a business worth billions of dollars, according to internal emails first reported by the Financial Times.

The discussions involve Freshfields global managing partner Alan Mason and Ethan Klingsberg, co-head of the firm’s US corporate and mergers and acquisitions practice. [...] Software businesses require continuing investment in engineering, cybersecurity, sales and customer support. They must also keep their products up to date as underlying AI models improve and customer needs change.

There is no guarantee that a technology business developed inside a law firm would achieve the same growth or valuation as a specialist software company.

The wider industry is still working out how to measure the financial returns from AI adoption.
